description: Unvalidated manually selected ROI candidates for the supplied outdoor walkway video only. Do not automatically apply to other footage.
coordinate_system: Original image pixels; origin top-left; x right, y down. Polygons describe ground regions; person assignment uses bbox bottom-center.
validation_notes: Geometry checked only; sampled visual review does not establish validity across every frame.
Twenty-pixel unassigned gap between zones prevents shared boundaries; it can affect transition counts.
Only a conservative central subset of the walkway is covered, not the entire visible pedestrian area.
Pedestrians and carried objects can occlude the ground and affect optical flow.
Far/near are image-depth labels, not walking directions or physical entrances/exits.
No metric area calibration, detections or inference validation has been performed.
Existing Zone JSON loader reads zones only and does not enforce candidate status or source hash.

zones.name: walkway_far
zones.description: Candidate central walkway farther from camera; not an entrance/exit designation.

zones.name: walkway_near
zones.description: Candidate central walkway closer to camera; excludes side stairs and right seating/planters.
